concepts.title: Homomorphism of modules over a commutative ring
concepts.description: An additive map f:M→N of modules over the same commutative ring satisfying f(rm)=rf(m).

concepts.title: Convergence of bounded monotone real sequences
concepts.description: Every bounded monotone sequence of real numbers converges.

concepts.title: Multiplicative algebraic group
concepts.description: The affine F-group G_m with R-points R×, represented by F[t,t⁻¹], whose coproduct sends t to t⊗t.

concepts.title: Nilpotent ideal of a commutative ring
concepts.description: An ideal I for which I^n=0 for some positive integer n, meaning every product of n elements of I is zero.

concepts.title: Continuous nonabelian 1-cocycle
concepts.description: For a topological group Γ acting continuously on a group H, a continuous map c:Γ→H satisfying c(στ)=c(σ)σ(c(τ)). Cocycles are equivalent when c′(σ)=h⁻¹c(σ)σ(h) for one h∈H.

concepts.title: Nonarchimedean local field
concepts.description: A field complete for a nontrivial discrete valuation and having a finite residue field.

concepts.title: Nonnegative grading on a commutative ring
concepts.description: A decomposition R=⊕_{n≥0}R_n of its additive group such that R_mR_n⊆R_{m+n} and 1∈R_0. Multiplication is ordinarily commutative; this does not mean the sign rule sometimes called graded commutativity.

concepts.title: Normal algebraic field extension
concepts.description: An algebraic extension L/F such that every irreducible polynomial over F with a root in L factors into linear polynomials over L.

concepts.title: Normal subgroup
concepts.description: A subgroup H of G satisfying gHg⁻¹=H for every g∈G.

concepts.title: Normalized local multiplicative norm on a number field
concepts.description: At a real place use the usual absolute value, at a complex place use the square of the usual complex modulus, and at a finite place v use |x|_v=(#k_v)^(−ord_v(x)), with |0|_v=0. The complex normalization is multiplicative but need not satisfy the ordinary triangle inequality.

concepts.title: Discriminant of a number field
concepts.description: For an integral basis ω₁,…,ω_n of F, the integer d_F=det(Tr_(F/Q)(ω_iω_j))_(i,j). A change of integral basis leaves this determinant unchanged.

concepts.title: Product formula for a number field
concepts.description: For every nonzero a in a number field F, ∏_v|a|_v=1 using normalized local multiplicative norms at every finite and infinite place. Only finitely many factors differ from1.

concepts.title: p-adic valuation of a rational number
concepts.description: For a prime p and nonzero rational x, v_p(x) is the unique integer r such that x=p^r a/b with integers a,b not divisible by p; put v_p(0)=+∞.

concepts.title: Strict separation of a point from a closed convex cone
concepts.description: If C is a nonempty closed convex cone in R^n and b∉C, there is y such that y·c≥0 for every c∈C and y·b<0.

concepts.title: Polynomial ring over a commutative ring
concepts.description: The ring R[X₁,…,X_n] of formal finite sums of monomials with coefficients in R, with coefficientwise addition and the usual multiplication of monomials.

concepts.title: Product topology
concepts.description: On a Cartesian product of topological spaces, the topology with basic open sets restricting finitely many coordinates to open subsets and leaving all other coordinates unrestricted.

concepts.title: Quotient of a commutative ring by an ideal
concepts.description: For an ideal I of R, the cosets R/I form a ring under (r+I)+(s+I)=r+s+I and (r+I)(s+I)=rs+I.

concepts.title: Quotient of a group by a normal subgroup
concepts.description: For a normal subgroup H of G, the cosets G/H form a group under (gH)(g′H)=gg′H.
